name: python
description: trailbeam (Python) client hooks on boto3. Needs a Python with the package and boto3 installed first on PATH.

variants.name: alone
variants.about: only Trailbeam: trailbeam.boto.install() instruments botocore with its own provider

variants.name: app-otel
variants.about: the application's own provider and stock botocore instrumentation, installed first

variants.name: app-otel-sampled-0
variants.about: as app-otel, with the application's sampler at 0%: Trailbeam's always-on provider must still export every span

variants.name: capture
variants.about: body capture on for every queue (contract 15): every send and receive must carry the body
